actions.actionName: Back Up Data with a Mouse
actions.description: It will keep your data safe

steps: Connect the adapter to your phone.
Connect the mouse's USB to the adapter.
Connect a keyboard the same way, so you are able to easily enter your PIN or Password.
Once you've backed up your data, please visit a Samsung walk-in service center, or you can schedule a repair service online.

actions.description: It will keep your data safe

steps: If your phone's screen is damaged and you can no longer see anything on it, you can back up your data by connecting it to your TV or monitor.
With some devices, you can also use a device like a DeX station or multi-port adapter to connect a mouse and keyboard in addition to HDMI.
Connect the adapter to your phone.
Connect the HDMI cable to the adapter.
Connect the other end of the HDMI cable to the HDMI port on the TV or monitor.
Once you've backed up your data, please visit a Samsung walk-in service center, or you can schedule a repair service online.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Blank Screen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Blank screen display

actions.actionName: Check for Physical Damage and Liquid Exposure
actions.description: It will reveal physical or liquid damage

steps: Remove any cases or accessories that might be covering the charging port or buttons.
Examine the USB connections for any corrosion or bent pins.
Turn off your phone or tablet.
Insert the ejector tool into the small hole next to the SIM/MicroSD tray to eject the tray.
Shine a flashlight into the SIM/MicroSD slot.

actions.description: It will restore enough battery power

steps: Connect your phone or tablet to its appropriate charger and let it charge for at least 1 hour.

actions.description: It will confirm the device starts

steps: Disconnect the phone or tablet from the charger.
Try to turn it on by pressing and holding the Power button (or Side button) for 15 to 20 seconds.
Turn off your device and reconnect it to the appropriate charger until it is fully charged.
In this case, please contact the Samsung Support Center for further assistance.

actions.description: It will reboot an unresponsive device

steps: Press and hold both the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
If your device has a removable battery, please remove the battery for 60 seconds, and then reinsert it.
